sentences.text: Mrs. Rutuja Ambekar, APP for the Respondent - State.

3. In view of the fact that the Apex Court has stayed the order of quashing in the matter of Anand Chaurasiya in SLP preferred by the State of Maharashtra, the doubt is raised on the applicability of Section 328 of the IPC to the facts of the present case.
4. In that view of the matter, adjourned to 6th January, 2022.

5. Applicant in the event of his arrest in C. R. No. 658 of 2021 registered with Shanti Nagar Police Station, Bhiwandi, Thane for the offence punishable under Sections 188, 272, 273, 328 of the IPC and Sections 26(2) 26(2)(iv) and 27 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 be released on bail on executing P. R. bond of Rs.25,000/- with one or more sureties in the like amount.
